We came in for anal gland expression and got spooked and left.

This is not a safe situation. There are tons of dogs hanging loose in the tight grooming area, with a few people, scissors, etc. They do not check for vaccines or behavior when letting dogs loose in the back. The facility is chaotic and scared my dog. There were multiple leaks in the front that were not being managed.

Another red flag: on the phone, I was told it would cost $20. When we showed up, they told me it would be more $ depending on the dog’s behavior and if she was aggressive. That did not make us feel confident and safe about their ability to handle our dog, not to mention the bait and switch is worrying.

I am not sure if there is a promotion or the reviews aren’t real or what, but this is not a safe situation for dogs.

I would never recommend this groomer to anyone. This was, without question, one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had with a business.

From the moment I addressed my concerns, I was spoken to with complete disrespect. Instead of treating me like a paying customer, I was spoken to as if I worked for them. The level of unprofessionalism was shocking.

The biggest issue was that they repeatedly ignored my grooming instructions. I clearly explained multiple times exactly how I wanted my dog’s hair cut, yet they did whatever they wanted instead. I specifically requested that my dog’s eyelashes not be cut, and when I questioned them afterward, I was blatantly lied to and told they hadn’t been cut, even though it was obvious they had.

If I’m paying premium prices for a professional grooming service, I expect the groomer to follow my instructions, be honest, and treat both me and my dog with respect. Instead, I left feeling frustrated, disrespected, and incredibly disappointed.

I also left deeply concerned about how some of the dogs were being handled while I was there. Based on what I personally witnessed, I would not feel comfortable trusting this business with my pet again.

People work hard for their money. Spend yours at a place that listens to its customers, treats animals with care, and values honesty and professionalism. I will never be returning.
